summary: A hotter-than-expected May CPI print of 4.2% year-over-year, fueled largely by Iran-driven energy costs, has reinforced higher-for-longer Fed bets and pressured risk assets. Escalating U.S.-Iran strikes near the Strait of Hormuz keep oil elevated and sentiment fragile across equities, gold, and crypto.
